name: convertory-pages-functions
description: Cloudflare Pages Functions for convertory-app.pages.dev (Merge PDF, Watermark PDF, Image to PDF, PDF to Text). See functions/api/convert.js. Also carries the Capacitor iOS shell (ms-store/ served as-is, no bundler).

scripts.ios:add: node scripts/ios-prepare-web.mjs && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: node scripts/ios-prepare-web.mjs && npx cap sync ios
